description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of categories across which a large language model's attribution was evaluated, with each slice corresponding to a specific domain and labeled with its percentage share. The chart contains ten distinct slices, each assigned a unique color and labeled with its category name and percentage value. The largest segment, colored blue, represents “AI/NLP Research” at 24.3%. The second largest, a teal segment, corresponds to “Econ. & Fin.” at 18.4%. Other significant segments include “Daily Life” (7.1%, light teal), “History” (8.2%, yellow), “Game&Anime” (8.2%, dark orange), and “Med & Health” (6.7%, green). Smaller segments include “Law” (5.1%, pink), “Science” (6.7%, light blue), “Business” (5.9%, red), “Geography” (2.7%, yellow-green), and “Math” (1.2%, dark green). Each category label and its percentage are connected to its respective slice by a thin line, and the chart includes a legend-like structure where each label is positioned next to its corresponding slice. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with “AI/NLP Research” being the largest and positioned prominently at the top right, followed by “Econ. & Fin.” and then proceeding clockwise through the remaining categories. No slices are visually emphasized or exploded.
